sources: Ontario Curriculum, Grades 1-8: Language (2023) — Strand B. Foundations of Language, OE B2 'Language Foundations for Reading and Writing' (official expectations PDF, dcp.edu.gov.on.ca / kc-usercontent.com). Verbatim.

Appendix A: Language Foundations Continuum for Reading and Writing, Grades 1-4 — the mandatory phonics scope & sequence elaborating B2 (implemented by the TCDSB 'Foundations of Language' program).
meta.note: B2 specific-expectation CODES shift per grade (each grade column renumbers). Phonemic Awareness/Alphabetic Knowledge/GPC appear explicitly only in Grade 1 (achieved with automaticity); Grades 2-3 carry them forward inside the consolidated phonics expectation. Cite the grade-correct code in every teacher guide.

expectations.title: Foundations for Reading and Writing
expectations.text: apply early reading and writing skills

expectations.section: Alphabetic Knowledge
expectations.text: name upper- and lowercase letters (both in and out of order)

expectations.section: Letter Formation
expectations.text: use proper formation patterns to write letters

expectations.section: Phonemic Awareness
expectations.text: isolate and blend phonemes, and segment simple words into phonemes

expectations.section: Phonics: Grapheme-Phoneme Correspondence
expectations.text: identify simple grapheme-phoneme correspondences

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling
expectations.text: read and spell simple words using phonemic awareness and phonics knowledge

expectations.section: Reading Fluency
expectations.text: read short sentences fluently, including those with explicitly taught words, with increasing accuracy, to support comprehension

expectations.title: Language Foundations for Reading and Writing
expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of foundational language knowledge and skills, and apply this understanding when reading and writing

expectations.section: Phonemic Awareness
expectations.text: use understanding of the sound structure of spoken words to orally isolate, blend, and segment phonemes, from simple structures with two phonemes to structures with more phonemes

expectations.section: Alphabetic Knowledge
expectations.text: name and form the upper- and lowercase letters both in and out of order and demonstrate knowledge of alphabetic order, with automaticity

expectations.section: Phonics: Grapheme-Phoneme Correspondence
expectations.text: identify, read, and spell most common grapheme-phoneme correspondences of consonants and vowels, with automaticity

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Phonics Knowledge
expectations.text: use phonics knowledge and phonemic blending to read words, and phonemic segmentation to spell phonetically regular words, in isolation and various text contexts

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Orthographic Knowledge
expectations.text: use developing orthographic knowledge, including position-based tendencies, to make a spelling choice or accurately pronounce a word when reading

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Morphological Knowledge
expectations.text: use developing knowledge of the meanings of words and common morphemes (i.e., bases, prefixes, and suffixes) to read and spell words

expectations.section: Vocabulary
expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of commonly used words, acquire and use explicitly taught vocabulary in various contexts, including other subject areas, and use their developing morphological knowledge to analyze and understand new words in context

expectations.section: Reading Fluency: Accuracy, Rate, and Prosody
expectations.text: read simple words, short sentences, and paragraphs in a variety of texts fluently, with accuracy and appropriate pacing to support comprehension, and read aloud with expression

expectations.title: Language Foundations for Reading and Writing
expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of foundational language knowledge and skills, and apply this understanding when reading and writing

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Phonics Knowledge
expectations.text: use phonics knowledge, including phonemic blending to read words and set for variability to correct approximations, and phonemic segmentation to spell phonetically regular monosyllabic and multisyllabic words, in isolation and various text contexts

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Orthographic Knowledge
expectations.text: use orthographic knowledge, including position-based tendencies, to make a spelling choice or accurately pronounce a word when reading

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Morphological Knowledge
expectations.text: use developing knowledge of the meanings of words and common morphemes (i.e., bases, prefixes, and suffixes) to read and spell words

expectations.section: Vocabulary
expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of a variety of words, acquire and use explicitly taught vocabulary in various contexts, including other subject areas, and use their developing morphological knowledge to analyze and understand new words in context

expectations.section: Reading Fluency: Accuracy, Rate, and Prosody
expectations.text: read words, sentences, and paragraphs in a variety of texts fluently, with accuracy and appropriate pacing to support comprehension, and read aloud with expression and intonation

expectations.title: Language Foundations for Reading and Writing
expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of foundational language knowledge and skills, and apply this understanding when reading and writing

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Phonics Knowledge
expectations.text: use consolidated phonics knowledge, including phonemic blending to read words and set for variability to correct approximations, and phonemic segmentation to spell phonetically regular monosyllabic and multisyllabic words, in isolation and various text contexts

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Orthographic Knowledge
expectations.text: use consolidated orthographic knowledge, including position-based tendencies, to make a spelling choice or accurately pronounce a word when reading

expectations.section: Word-Level Reading and Spelling: Using Morphological Knowledge
expectations.text: use developing knowledge of the meanings of words and morphemes (i.e., bases, prefixes, and suffixes) to read and spell words

expectations.section: Vocabulary
expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of a variety of words, acquire and use explicitly taught vocabulary in various contexts, including other subject areas, and use morphological knowledge to analyze and understand new words in context

expectations.section: Reading Fluency: Accuracy, Rate, and Prosody
expectations.text: read words, complex sentences, and paragraphs in a variety of texts fluently, with accuracy and appropriate pacing to support comprehension, and read aloud using varied expression and intonation according to the purpose of reading
